subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this one-way device-identity cutover, requiring Doctor migration and coordinated versions for processes that share one state directory?
rationale: The code can preserve key material and fail closed, but only maintainers can accept the operational contract that older JSON-only binaries are unsupported after migration.

options.title: Accept the one-way cutover
options.body: Merge with the documented Doctor-only import and coordinated-version requirement, preserving the current downgrade warning and recovery guidance.

options.title: Require backward-compatible coexistence
options.body: Keep legacy JSON readable until an explicitly designed compatibility and retirement policy is approved, accepting the additional runtime complexity.

options.title: Defer the migration
options.body: Pause this PR and its stacked follow-up until a release/rollback policy for shared state directories is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the one-way cutover
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented Doctor-only import and coordinated-version requirement, preserving the current downgrade warning and recovery guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current migration series and can supply the precise upgrade and Apple interoperability context for the maintainer decision.
